title: Vilna Rising
author: A. M. Vasquez
blurb: Orsen Ashgrove, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ice breaks on the river.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
